# London Furnace Repair

> From its base in London, Middlesex County, London Furnace Repair serves homeowners with residential HVAC work: emergency furnace repair, AC tune-ups and replacements, ductless mini-splits, cold-climate heat pumps, gas fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (548) 457-2462  |  Email: contact@londonfurnacerepair.ca  |  Website: https://londonfurnacerepair.ca

Service areas: London, St. Thomas, Strathroy, Dorchester, Komoka, Aylmer, Lucan
